purpose: Document authoritative runtime data, generated outputs, archives, and retired transitional datasets.
principles: Known undesirable information may eliminate a candidate.
Unknown information remains eligible and reduces confidence rather than causing elimination.
Each fact should have one authoritative managed source; summaries and validation reports should be generated.

managed.role: Canonical boat model specifications, normalized classifications and model-level research metadata.
Primary boat-model field definitions, controlled values, ownership and retired-field migration rules.
Canonical physical route constraints used by filtering and route compatibility.
Reusable user mission and search configurations; not route data.
Curated development and research priority fleet.
Canonical marketplace and brokerage source registry.
Canonical model identity registry, aliases and relationships.
Model-level interpretation, ownership trade-offs and recommendations.
Known conflicts between evidence or claims.
Curated manuals, videos, owner groups and research links.
Structured model facts and their confidence.
Manufacturer-level research awaiting fuller runtime integration.

generated.role: Generated presentation view composed from authoritative knowledge sources.

retired.reason: Duplicated route records using inconsistent string types and contained an empty record.
All current IDs are migrated; legacy identifiers are resolved directly through canonical registry aliases.

knowledgeOwnership.boatmodels.json: Canonical model identity and core specifications
knowledgeOwnership.knowledge/data/knowledgeannotations.json: Canonical model cautions, missing-information notes and editorial relationships
knowledgeOwnership.knowledge/data/knowledgecards.json: Generated presentation view; do not edit manually
knowledgeOwnership.knowledge/data/manufacturerknowledge.jso: Canonical manufacturer and family knowledge, available through the runtime manufacturer knowledge repository
knowledgeOwnership.data/marketplace-sources.json: Canonical marketplace and brokerage source registry

archives.role: Historical legacy-ID map and registry migration/audit metadata; not loaded at runtime.
